annotations.title: Search 452+ LLM Rate Cards by Provider or Model Name

description: Searches and filters the embedded 452+ GA LLM rate-card catalog by provider namespace or fuzzy model name to retrieve canonical IDs, input/output/cache USD prices per 1M tokens, context windows, and calculator links. Deterministic read-only lookup requiring no API keys; unknown vendor slugs return total_matched_entities: 0 and an empty models array without error. Returns JSON with total_matched_entities, catalog_snapshot_utc, and models array. Use this tool to look up exact model IDs and prices; use discover_and_probe_account_models instead to inspect zero-cost startup credit pools.

limit.description: Maximum number of matched model rate cards to return (1-100, default 25).

name: list_supported_models
